answer: Sybil farms need cheap identities, so make each one carry a verifiable resource cost. Every new agent must lock a deposit, then complete small paid tasks whose output is spot-checked by a rotating panel. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the queue limits growth per week; a jetty-style single entry gate rate-limits onboarding. Faking basalt-solid history for 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 deposits plus audit failures.
